tldrHtmlBlock: To identify broken AI citation links, auditors should regularly crawl referred URLs and monitor server logs for four-oh-four errors. When a decayed or missing destination is detected, teams can map the outdated path to a relevant, live replacement using three-oh-one redirects. Maintaining accurate canonical tags, structured metadata, and consistent link taxonomies helps preserve referral integrity across crawlers. Evaluating link health requires testing endpoint status codes and verifying that target content aligns with original topics without introducing unintended redirect loops today.
